_comment: Status effect definitions (Steve 2026-10-07). Data-driven status framework: the engine (src/js/statusEffects.js) reads these. Scopes: scholar (dayPart ticks via advancePart), combat (per-turn ticks via tbBeginTurn). Stun-family bridges legacy stunned/stunFull fields so existing consumption code keeps working. Poison/disease mirror s.poisons/s.diseases so herbal_remedy/purify keep working. DISEASE REWORK (Steve 2026-10-09): diseases never announce their names — apply/tick/expire text is symptom-only; the true name unlocks only via diagnosis. Each disease has a class (bacterial/parasitic/viral/fever) that gates medicine specificity, a tiered cure table (cure/ease/support/slow/no per ability and medicine), and debuffs that degrade the body while sick.

bleed.description: Open wound. It won't close on its own while you keep moving.
bleed.name: Bleeding

burn.description: Skin seared. The heat keeps eating.
burn.name: Burning

disease.cureText: Bitter tea, steam, rest. The fever breaks. ({source})
disease.description: Fever by nightfall. The body fights something it can't see.
disease.expireText: The fever breaks on its own. {name} {verb} through it.
disease.name: Fever
disease.diagnosedDesc: No name for this one — just fever. The body fighting something it can't see.
disease.vectors: Bad food, bad water, bad luck.

fear.description: Something in the gut says run. The hands don't always listen.
fear.name: Afraid

poison.cureText: Charcoal, clean water, time. The poison leaves. ({source})
poison.description: Toxin in the blood. It burns through you a little at a time.
poison.expireText: The poison runs its course. {name} {verb} through it.
poison.name: Poisoned

slow.description: Heavy limbs. Every step costs double.
slow.name: Slowed
slow.notes: v1: player moveLeft wired in tbBeginTurn. Monster step loops (m.speed) pending — engine API seMoveMod/seSteps ready.

stun.description: Frozen mid-step. Movement is gone, but the hands still work.
stun.name: Stunned

stun_full.description: The world tilts. The whole turn slips past.
stun_full.name: Stunned (full)

howlbelly.description: Howlbelly (hushwolf meat): at night you howl without deciding to — wanderers hear it. Small monsters hear what's in your gut and think twice.
howlbelly.expireText: The ache fades. Your throat is your own again.
howlbelly.transformation: Your throat restructures overnight — a second voice-box, canine, sits under your jaw. It howls without asking.
howlbelly.name: Howlbelly

gristlefit.description: Gristlefit (bulldozer meat): +25% strike damage, but rage fits may lash out at whoever's nearest — friend or foe.
gristlefit.expireText: Your shoulders drop. The world stops insulting you.
gristlefit.transformation: Knots of gristle braid through your shoulders and neck. They twitch before you decide to move.
gristlefit.name: Gristlefit

croakbelly.cureText: One last ribbit, small and sad. ({source})
croakbelly.description: Croakbelly (choir toad meat): your gut ribbits audibly (-stealth), but choir toads hear kin and won't start anything.
croakbelly.expireText: One last ribbit, small and sad. Gone.
croakbelly.transformation: A vocal sac swells under your chin, translucent and pulsing. It ribbits when your gut does.
croakbelly.name: Croakbelly

shellgut.description: Shellgut (speedbump meat): gut armored — immune to ingested poison and food-borne disease, but food moves slow (-25% kcal absorbed, digestion clanks).
shellgut.expireText: The armor passes. Loudly. You don't look back.
shellgut.transformation: Plates of dull chitin tile your abdomen under the skin. Your digestion clanks.
shellgut.name: Shellgut

witness_maw.description: Witness Maw (grief counselor meat): black tears, night half as dark — but people decide you're possessed (-trust).
witness_maw.expireText: Your tears run clear again. People stop edging away.
witness_maw.transformation: Your tear ducts run black and will not stop. At night your eyes reflect like a nocturnal animal’s.
witness_maw.name: Witness Maw

flockmind.description: Flockmind (duck-line meat): you quack when startled — surprise is impossible — but duck-lines recognize flock and won't start anything.
flockmind.expireText: The urge to follow fades. You walk like yourself again. Probably.
flockmind.transformation: Fine down feathers push through your forearms. You preen without noticing.
flockmind.name: Flockmind

gutrot.name: Gut Rot
gutrot.applyText: {name} {verb} wrong in the gut — {source}. Something churns down there, and it isn't settling.
gutrot.expireText: The churning eases. {name} {verb} keeping food down again.
gutrot.description: Nausea in waves, cramps that double you over. Whatever is in the gut isn't food anymore.
gutrot.diagnosedDesc: Gut Rot — a gut parasite, the kind that rides dirty water and raw meat. Fluids and rest starve it; the right pills end it fast.
gutrot.vectors: Raw meat, risky water, dirty hands.

trichinosis.name: Trichinosis
trichinosis.applyText: {name}'s muscles ache like {name} {verb} been beaten — {source}. A low fever sits behind the eyes.
trichinosis.tickText: The deep ache settles further into {name}'s muscles. (-{n} HP)
trichinosis.expireText: The ache lets go, slowly, like a fist unclenching. {name} {verb} moving like {name}self again.
trichinosis.description: Muscle pain everywhere, as if beaten in the night. Fever that never quite breaks. It came from meat.
trichinosis.diagnosedDesc: Trichinosis — worms in the muscle, from undercooked bear or boar. Cooking to 160°F kills it; once it's in you, only antiparasitics truly clear it. Tea eases the ache; rest outlasts it, barely.

lemons.name: Lemons
lemons.applyText: {name} {verb} tired in the bones — {source}. The joints ache, and a ringed red circle blooms on the skin.
lemons.tickText: The joints throb; everything costs more than it should. (-{n} HP)
lemons.description: Aching joints, a tiredness that sleep doesn't fix, and a ringed rash where something bit.
lemons.diagnosedDesc: Lemons — a bacterial hitchhiker from tick bites. Antibiotics end it, but only if you know what you're treating. Ignored, it can settle into the joints for weeks.
lemons.vectors: Tick bites. Check the hide, check yourself.

chronic.text: The fever's gone, but the joints never quite forgave you — they ache for weeks. (Lemons, untreated.)

eurika.name: Eurika
eurika.applyText: Fever by nightfall — {source}. {name}'s skin prickles with a fine rash; the eyes itch.
eurika.tickText: Fever grips {name}, the rash burning. (-{n} HP)
eurika.expireText: The rash fades to nothing. The fever lets go.
eurika.description: Fever, a fine itching rash, eyes that won't stop watering. It burns through and burns out.
eurika.diagnosedDesc: Eurika — a mosquito virus. No pill touches it; the body has to win. Rest, clean water, and bitter tea see you through.
eurika.vectors: Mosquito bites, dusk near still water.

east_nile.name: East Nile
east_nile.applyText: {name} {verb} burning up — {source}. The headache sits behind the eyes like a stone.
east_nile.expireText: The fever breaks all at once, sweat pouring off. {name} {verb} wrung out and alive.
east_nile.description: High fever and a headache like a stone behind the eyes. In some, it turns — confusion, worse. Those ones don't always come back.
east_nile.diagnosedDesc: East Nile — a mosquito virus with teeth. Most cases pass; the bad ones escalate and can kill. No cure — only care: someone skilled keeping the fever down and the water going in.

severe.text: By dusk {name} {verb} not making sense — words wrong, eyes wrong. This is the bad kind. (East Nile, severe.)

lockjaw.name: Lockjaw
lockjaw.applyText: {name}'s jaw aches — {source}. Smiling hurts. The neck is going stiff.
lockjaw.tickText: Spasms run through {name} like a struck wire. (-{n} HP)
lockjaw.expireText: The stiffness lets go by inches. {name} {verb} opening {name} mouth without thinking about it.
lockjaw.description: A jaw that won't open right, a neck going rigid, spasms like a struck wire. It came in through a cut.
lockjaw.diagnosedDesc: Lockjaw — bacteria from rust and dirt, settled into a wound. Without real treatment it kills. Antibiotics end it; skilled wound care (triage, field medicine) can turn it — but only if you know what you're treating.

spasm.text: A spasm locks {name}'s back rigid — white-knuckled, breathless. (-{n} HP)

wound_fever.name: Wound Fever
wound_fever.applyText: The cut throbs hot — {source}. Red streaks crawl out from the wound's edges.
wound_fever.tickText: Heat pulses from the wound, sick and steady. (-{n} HP)
wound_fever.expireText: The red streaks fade back into the cut. It itches, cleanly, healing.
wound_fever.description: An infected wound: hot, throbbing, red streaks crawling outward. Clean it or lose to it.
wound_fever.diagnosedDesc: Wound Fever — infection in an open cut. Clean it properly (field medicine, triage), poultice it (herbal), or hit it with antibiotics. All three work.
